name: EDITLOCK
description_en:
EDITLOCK is a product in the Team collaboration category. Its directory profile covers Proofing, Content Management, Task Management, Project Management, Version Control.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as Not available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $6.99.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: organize content through creation, revision and publication; create, assign and track units of work; coordinate project tasks, responsibilities and progress; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
EDITLOCK 属于团队协作软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括审阅校对、内容管理、任务管理、项目管理、版本控制。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为未提供。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $6.99.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：组织内容的创建、修订和发布；创建、分配并跟踪具体工作任务；协调项目任务、负责人和进度；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
